skill.name: lovable
skill.description: Guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code when working with Lovable.dev projects. It explains GitHub sync rules, Supabase deployment prompts, migrations, secrets, and Lovable project structure.
skill.summary: Guides Lovable GitHub sync, Supabase deployment, and project workflow prompts.
skill.author: 10K-Digital

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are Markdown false positives from inline code, prompt examples, placeholder URLs, and documented secret names. No prompt injection or credential exfiltration text was found. Two contextual risks remain: broad GitHub push guidance and optional yolo automation that can submit Lovable deployment actions.

remediation.issue: The template recommends git add . and pushing directly to main.
remediation.suggestion: Require an explicit user confirmation step, show the staged file list, and prefer selective staging before any push.

remediation.issue: Yolo mode can auto-submit deployment prompts through MCP or browser automation.
remediation.suggestion: Keep yolo mode off by default, require approval before each deployment action, and log the exact prompt sent.

remediation.issue: Secret detection references environment files and secret names.
remediation.suggestion: State that real .env values must not be printed, committed, or sent to external services; only secret names should be recorded.

content.user_title: Guide Lovable Deployments with Claude Code
content.value_statement: Lovable projects need careful GitHub, Supabase, and deployment coordination. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code structured prompts and workflow rules for Lovable backend changes.
actual_capabilities: Detects Vite SPA and TanStack Start project architecture from config files.
Explains which Lovable project files sync automatically through GitHub.
Provides Lovable prompts for edge functions, migrations, RLS policies, storage, and auth.
Documents yolo mode for automated deployment workflows.
Lists secret detection patterns for Supabase Edge Functions and common services.
Includes project structure map templates for Lovable applications.
limitations: Does not deploy Supabase Edge Functions by itself without separate automation.
Relies on Lovable project conventions and may need adjustment for nonstandard repositories.
Does not verify live Lovable account access or Cloud secret status.
Automated yolo workflows require separate browser or MCP setup.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Lovable Backend Changes
use_cases.description: Plan edge function, migration, and secret updates while knowing what GitHub sync can and cannot deploy.
use_cases.target_user: Full stack developers using Lovable and Supabase

use_cases.title: Prepare Safe Deployment Prompts
use_cases.description: Generate exact Lovable prompts for database, RLS, storage, auth, and edge function operations.

use_cases.title: Map a Lovable Codebase
use_cases.description: Document project architecture, key files, data flow, and common navigation paths for faster AI assistance.
use_cases.target_user: Teams onboarding Claude Code or Codex to a Lovable repository

prompt_templates.title: Identify Project Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether this Lovable project uses Vite SPA or TanStack Start. Tell me which files sync automatically and what needs Lovable deployment.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Edge Function Deployment
prompt_templates.prompt: I changed the [function name] edge function. Review the changes, list required secrets, and give me the exact Lovable deployment prompt.

prompt_templates.title: Apply a Migration Safely
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the pending Supabase migration for destructive changes. Explain the risk, then provide the Lovable prompt to apply it if safe.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Controlled Yolo Automation
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess whether yolo mode is appropriate for this project. If it is, define the deployment method, testing level, and manual fallback.

output_examples.input: User asks to deploy the send-email edge function after code changes.
output: The skill identifies that Supabase Edge Functions need Lovable deployment.
It returns the prompt: Deploy the send-email edge function.
It warns to confirm required secrets before deployment.

output_examples.input: User creates a migration for a profiles table.
output_examples.output: The skill explains that migration files sync through GitHub but need Lovable to apply. It provides a review checklist and the apply migration prompt.

output_examples.input: User asks why changes are not visible in Lovable.
output_examples.output: The skill checks branch, push status, and sync delay. It recommends waiting one to two minutes after pushing to main.

best_practices: Review generated Lovable prompts before running them in production.
Confirm branch, staged files, and secrets before any GitHub push.
Use yolo mode only with explicit deployment settings and verification tests.
anti_patterns: Running broad git add and push commands without reviewing staged files.
Applying database migrations before checking RLS, data loss, and rollback impact.
Treating preview tokens, API keys, or .env values as safe to commit.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps AI agents understand Lovable GitHub sync, Supabase deployment prompts, migrations, secrets, and project structure.

faq.question: Does it support both Lovable architectures?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents Vite SPA projects and TanStack Start projects, including their different file locations.

faq.question: Can it deploy edge functions directly?
faq.answer: Not by itself. It provides Lovable prompts, and optional yolo automation can submit them when separately configured.

faq.question: Does it manage secrets?
faq.answer: It documents how to detect required secret names and where to add them in Lovable Cloud.

faq.question: Is it useful with Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. Codex can use the guidance to plan Lovable-safe edits and prepare deployment instructions.

faq.question: What should users review before publishing?
faq.answer: Users should review staged files, migration impact, required secrets, and any automated deployment settings.
